listing.blurb: Translucent comb jellies pulse and swim through an abyssal void, trailing glowing tentacles and scattering bioluminescent marine snow across the deep sea.
listing.prompt: Deep-sea jellyfish drifting in the dark: translucent bells pulsing, trailing long tentacles, rainbow light running along their comb rows, marine snow falling slowly past them. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
